snapshot_caveat: Current main is after the uploaded2026paper publication; no paper-specific tag/commit binding verified. Read-only code observations must not be used to assert all published runs used this exact revision.
access_method: GitHub connector, read-only; no repository scripts executed, no datasets/weights/dependencies downloaded
read_scope: README and five core source files; cached text copies in ignored outputs directory only

findings.observation: Every support embedding is used as a reference point; softmax(-Euclidean distance/temperature) weights are multiplied by the continuous support target vector. Training uses MSE. The unused foreground/background helper is not the regression execution path.
findings.implication: For origin classification use class prototypes and categorical targets/cross-entropy, or a clearly specified classification variant; do not feed arbitrary origin integers into this regression head. Convex weighting also limits regression predictions to the support-target range.

findings.observation: Evaluation uses torch.no_grad and does not adapt the encoder; the new task is represented by its support embeddings/labels. During meta-training query labels intentionally supervise the encoder loss.
findings.implication: Separate source/meta-training query labels from held-out target query labels; using source query loss for meta-training is expected.

findings.observation: Target adaptation gradients are computed on the support DataLoader only; query metrics are computed under no_grad after each adaptation epoch. The function returns the final epoch, with no query-best selection visible in this function.
findings.implication: Do not call it target-query label leakage merely because query_y is passed for metrics. A future user must still avoid tuning epochs/hyperparameters on those logged final query metrics.

findings.observation: MixedDataset fits preprocessing, including y StandardScaler, on the entire task support pool before MixedTask.sample draws K labels. Query is transformed, not used to fit the scaler. The transform object is reused across tasks but outputs are materialized immediately.
findings.implication: A strict K-label target protocol must fit target-label normalization on the selected K labels, use a source-only fixed scale, or explicitly count the extra labelled pool statistics. This is an extra-support-label information condition, not query-y fit leakage. Affine normalization commutes with this ProtoNet weighted mean and R2 is affine invariant, so the impact is model/metric specific, not proof all published results are invalid.

findings.observation: FT pretraining gradients use source support; source query is used under no_grad for source validation metrics. ProtoNet training samples source support/query and propagates query MSE.
findings.implication: When adapting the design, match and disclose how source samples/labels are allocated to gradient training and validation. This is a difference in current visible training paths, not proof that all published comparisons were unfair.

findings.observation: Distance tensor uses unconditional .cuda(); MixedTask/MixedDataset default device=cuda, and the training script does not pass its CPU/GPU selection into these dataset constructors.
findings.implication: CPU-only reuse requires replacing hard-coded devices and explicitly propagating device. No runtime attempt was made here.

findings.observation: The loader trusts splits.csv and separate support/query CSVs, retaining row indices. The reviewed source does not verify physical sample IDs, repeated scans, duplicate spectra, batches, or cross-task physical overlap.
findings.implication: Our THz work must retain herb/pellet/scan/batch IDs and audit them across source/support/query; separate CSV files alone are insufficient proof.

findings.observation: Fixed sampled support/query indices are cached by shot count in dataset directories; query_dataloader then permits full query-pool evaluation. Cached support draws can persist across repeats and methods.
findings.implication: Specify whether repeats vary model seeds, support sampling or both. For a clean calibration curve fix an independent query pool and use nested support draws across K; do not claim cached repeated runs are independent support resamples.

findings.observation: ProtoNet SG is optional via --savgol (default false); FT hardcodes savgol=True with15-point/order2/first derivative.
findings.implication: Match actual preprocessing flags and physical spectral spacing for fair comparison. Do not treat README example commands as a verified reproduction of the paper configuration.

findings.observation: The limited read covered the five source files listed in this audit; it did not verify SimCLR+FT/PR implementation.
findings.implication: The paper methods can be described from its PDF, but this source audit cannot certify their implementation or model-head architecture.
